verdict.rationale: Quo is a SaaS business-phone platform with desktop, mobile and web apps, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry setting, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking control. The pack covers the API, MCP, webhooks, versioning and pricing instead, none of which bears on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
